rows.query: Can I send back a face serum that I have already opened?
rows.answer: Beauty products can be returned within 7 days only if the seal is unbroken and the product is unused, because opened cosmetics cannot be resold for hygiene reasons. Every return must include the original tags, packaging and any free gifts, otherwise it may be rejected at quality check.

rows.query: What happens to my COD refund if the bank details I gave are wrong?
rows.answer: For Cash-on-Delivery orders, a refund is issued only after the returned item passes quality check at the Nykaa warehouse. If the bank details are wrong the transfer fails, and it is retried once the customer updates the details, which restarts the 5 to 7 business day timeline.

rows.query: Is next-day delivery possible, and is there a cut-off time?
rows.answer: Express delivery arrives on the next business day for eligible pin codes when the order is placed before 2 PM. An order is flagged as a delayed shipment once it misses the upper limit of its promised delivery SLA.

rows.query: My pin code is not serviced for pickups. How do I return my item?
rows.answer: It is available only while the order is inside its return window and only for pin codes served by Nykaa's reverse-logistics partners. Customers in non-serviceable pin codes must self-ship the item and receive up to Rs 150 in their Nykaa Wallet as a shipping reimbursement.

rows.query: Does the warranty cover a hair dryer that I dropped and broke?
rows.answer: Electronics such as hair dryers, straighteners and trimmers carry a 12-month manufacturer warranty from the delivery date, serviced at the brand's authorised service centres with the Nykaa invoice as proof of purchase. The warranty does not cover physical damage, liquid damage or misuse.

rows.query: I want to cancel NYK-1015 but it has already shipped. Is that possible?
rows.answer: Order NYK-1015 (Apparel, Rs 5,649) is currently Shipped, placed 8 days ago. Its escalation score is 0.11, below the 0.70 threshold, so no escalation is needed. Relevant policy: An order can be cancelled free of charge from the app or website at any time while its status is Placed. Once an order has Shipped it can no longer be cancelled, unless the shipment has been flagged as delayed, so the customer should instead refuse the delivery or raise a return after it arrives.

rows.query: What is the maximum part of my bill I can pay with reward points?
rows.answer: Customers earn Nykaa reward points on every delivered order at 1 point per Rs 100 spent, with higher earning rates for premium-tier members. One reward point is worth Rs 1, and points can pay for up to 50% of an order's value on orders of at least Rs 500.

rows.query: How many times am I allowed to retry a failed payment?
rows.answer: If a payment fails but money has been debited from the customer's account, no order is created and the bank or payment gateway reverses the amount automatically within 5 to 7 business days. A failed payment can be retried at most 3 times for the same order, after which the order is cancelled and the items are released back to inventory.

rows.query: Can I exchange my lipstick for a different shade or size?
rows.answer: Apparel and Footwear can be exchanged for a different size of the same product within 15 days of delivery, provided the item is unworn and still has its original tags. Each item can be exchanged only once, and only if the new size is in stock; otherwise the customer is offered a refund instead.

rows.query: What proof do I need to submit when my delivery arrives damaged?
rows.answer: If an item arrives damaged, defective or different from what was ordered, the customer must raise a claim from the order details page within 48 hours of delivery. The claim must include clear photos of the item, the outer box and the shipping label, and an unboxing video is strongly recommended for Electronics.

rows.query: I live abroad. Can I pay with a card issued by a UK bank?
rows.answer: Nykaa currently delivers only to addresses within India, and international addresses cannot be saved at checkout. Customers living abroad can order for delivery to an Indian address, but they must pay with an Indian-issued card, UPI or Nykaa Wallet.

rows.query: Who handles a complaint about being charged twice for the same order?
rows.answer: If a payment fails but money has been debited from the customer's account, no order is created and the bank or payment gateway reverses the amount automatically within 5 to 7 business days. A failed payment can be retried at most 3 times for the same order, after which the order is cancelled and the items are released back to inventory.
